_notes.source: Live https://phidiaspropfirm.com/ account configurator read in Chrome on 2026-10-20 (Express to Live, Fundamental, Premium; every size; 'One-Time Payment'; platform choice does not change the price), /affiliate-program, Trustpilot (20 newest reviews) and Google Maps. Earlier sources listed in git history.
_notes.pricing: Each account can be bought as a one-time payment with no fees after passing (recorded: standard = 'without code' price, promo = price with code BIG50 as displayed) or a cheaper evaluation fee plus an activation fee after passing (not recorded). Discount shown on 2026-10-20: 75-85% depending on size. The full one-time prices for Fundamental and Premium have risen a lot since 2026-10-11 (e.g. Premium 50K $275 -> $723) while the discounted prices stayed similar, and Fundamental is now labelled 'Professional Intraday'. A pop-up giveaway offers an 80% code in exchange for an email (not entered).
_notes.rules_detail: Express to Live: static drawdown, no daily loss limit, no consistency rule, no minimum days; hitting the target on the funded (Cash) account gives a bonus payout (80/20) and moves you to a live account. Fundamental: EOD trailing drawdown, no daily loss limit, no consistency rule in the evaluation, 30% max-day rule on the funded account, 3 minimum days, 10 funded days per payout. Premium: same targets and drawdowns, 1 minimum day, can hold overnight and over weekends, profit split rises 75% / 80% / 85% / 90% / 100% over payouts 1-5 (recorded as 100).
_notes.not_listed: The 10K Drawdown Challenge (entry-fee contest) is not listed.
_notes.company: Footer: Phidias Propfirm LTD, registered in Gibraltar. The site says '3 years operating' but states no founding date.
_notes.marketing_wording: The site says it has never denied a payout; recent reviews (see vetting) say otherwise. The review alert shows both.
_notes.vetting: Checked 2026-10-11. Of the 20 newest Trustpilot reviews, about 8 described a refused payout or a ban around a payout request; the firm replied to none. Trustpilot hides its score for a guideline breach (339 reviews). Listed with a review alert at the team's request (2026-10-11).
_notes.rule_units: Futures rules are fixed USD amounts per account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on an official Phidias page we could read.
_notes.premium_daily_loss: Premium's feature list doesn't say 'No Daily Loss Limit' (Fundamental's and Express to Live's do), so Premium daily_loss is null until confirmed.
_notes.affiliate_program: https://phidiaspropfirm.com/affiliate-program (2026-10-20): 15% starting commission on every sale made with the affiliate's own coupon code; code-based attribution only ('No cookies, no tracking links'). Paid monthly via Rise on confirmed sales. Free to apply via the form on that page. Minimum payout, country and comparison-site rules not stated.
_notes.company_check: Google Maps search (2026-10-20) found no Phidias listing.
_notes.tier_rename: 2026-10-20: tier 'Fundamental' renamed 'Professional Intraday' to match the Phidias site. Older notes still say Fundamental.

firm.name: Phidias
firm.about: Phidias is a Gibraltar-registered futures prop firm with three account types: Express to Live (static drawdown, aimed at a fast move to a live account), Professional Intraday and Premium (can hold overnight). Accounts run from $25K to $150K on Tradovate, Rithmic, NinjaTrader, TradingView or DeepCharts.

countries.notes: Crimea is also listed. 'Slovenia and Yugoslavia' is recorded as Slovenia and Serbia; Kosovo is coded XK (widely used, not an official ISO code).

reviews.trustpilot_note: Trustpilot is not showing a score for this firm. Its page says this is because of a breach of Trustpilot's guidelines (339 reviews, checked 11 Oct 2026).
reviews.google_note: We couldn't find a Google rating for this firm.

review_alert.summary: Of the 20 most recent Trustpilot reviews (read 20 October 2026), about 7 describe a payout being refused or the reviewer being banned around a payout request, and none of these had a reply from the firm. The firm says on its own website that it has never denied a payout. Trustpilot is also not showing a score for this firm; its page says this is because of a breach of its guidelines.
